claims: A fixed smooth unforced periodic NS datum has pointwise initial helicity zero, but h(t,x*)=-t/3+O(t^2) for every fixed positive viscosity; a reflection symmetry simultaneously keeps total helicity zero throughout its smooth interval.

The elementary six-term formula printed in Tao arXiv1402.0290v3 Remark4.3 fails its claimed universal curl cancellation on admissible real divergence-free Schwartz test fields; the displayed inverse-curl sign also differs from the true inverse.
A corrected elementary formula has energy and curl cancellations, preserves the odd-field dynamics and the exact local-cascade class, with convergent scale sums for H10 inputs.
These local checks do not provide an unconditional regularity estimate or select a new arbitrary-data candidate.
limitations: No original-NS blowup, general regularity, new critical bound, arbitrary-candidate singularity coverage, novelty or human peer-review claim.

Near-initial-time construction only; constants and the time window may depend on fixed viscosity. Zero total helicity is preserved by the specific reflection symmetry, not by every zero-helicity datum.
Only the arXiv v3 formula was visually verified. Formal JAMS formula bytes and a complete erratum registry were not checked; bounded negative searches are not proof that no correction exists.
The elementary formula failure is not a disproof of Tao's main theorem. The corrected elementary interface is not a reproof of the complete averaged-NS blowup construction or representation theorem.

HS already contains the global critical-difference identity and helical spectral-sector leakage; these are not new mechanisms. Reverse first-cycle data and its numerical remainder certificate are not reused as this example's certificate.
